detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #55 Emergency Nuke Password Your emergency response, built into the screen lock. During session setup, you can optionally configure a separate emergency password alongside your normal session password. Entering it at screen unlock immediately starts the PH4NTXM Panic/Nuke workflow. No confirmation dialog. No additional steps. Emergency authentication never unlocks the session. The normal password continues to unlock as usual. The emergency trigger applies only at screen unlock, keeping login, sudo and device approvals separate. Only a salted emergency password hash is kept in RAM for the current boot. No persistent configuration. The feature remains disabled unless you explicitly enable it. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
